title: Induced topological edge and terminal map
statement: Let f:Z -> X be a continuous map of topological spaces. Let HX and HZ be the recorded abelian-sheaf cohomology functors evaluated at the terminal opens, identified by specified equalities [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Assume the sectionwise direct-image functor is additive [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. There exists a natural map edge_p:HX^p(f_*F) -> HZ^p(F), and a map a from the free abelian terminal sheaf KX to f_*KZ, sending each sheafification generator h:U -> X to the generator f^{-1}(h) followed by f^{-1}(X)=Z. For every injective resolution I of F, every injective resolution J of f_*F, every chain map phi:J -> f_*I over f_*F, and every pair of degree-p cocycles s:KX -> J^p and z:KZ -> I^p satisfying a composed with f_*z = s composed with phi^p, edge_p sends the Ext class represented by s in J to the class represented by z in I, after transporting by the specified HX,HZ equalities. This statement asserts no spectral-sequence data.

source.place: Section 01DZ, composition comparison of Section 20.13; Tag 01F2

proof.text: Use the sheafPullbackConstruction adjunction L ⊣ P for Opens.map f. Additivity of L follows from adj.left_adjoint_additive and the assumed additivity of P. The left adjoint preserves colimits. Mathlib lan_preservesFiniteLimits_of_flat and instPreservesFiniteLimitsSheafSheafPullback supply preservation of finite limits, so L is exact.

The composite of sheafificationAdjunction.homEquiv, the whiskered AddCommGrpCat.adj.homEquiv, and yonedaEquiv represents sections by the sheafified free representable. Apply the unit KX -> P(L(KX)) to the universal terminal generator; restrict along the equality Opens.map_top f to obtain a terminal section of L(KX), and apply the inverse representing equivalence to construct b:KZ -> L(KX). These are actual adjunction constructions, with no witness chosen from a mere existence theorem.

Construct edge_p on Ext by L.mapExtAddHom, precomposition with Ext.mk₀ b, and postcomposition with Ext.mk₀ of the counit L(P(F)) -> F. Its naturality follows by mapExactFunctor_comp, mapExactFunctor_mk₀, the degree-zero Ext associativity lemmas, mk₀_comp_mk₀, and counit naturality. Rewrite HX and HZ by funext hX and funext hZ to give the required functors. This proves the existing Lean conclusion, which does not contain the resolution-cocycle compatibility clause of the natural-language node.

Define the representable presheaf transformation h ↦ (Opens.map f).map h composed with eqToHom(Opens.map_top f). Naturality holds because Opens is a thin category. Whisker with AddCommGrpCat.free, then compose with the inverse-image restriction of toSheafify on Z. Use sheafifyLift on X to obtain a:KX -> P(KZ). Evaluating toSheafify_sheafifyLift on each generator proves exactly the required generator formula. No injective-resolution comparison or spectral-sequence lemma is required by this existential conclusion.
